key_insight: QPipe uses a multi-agent LLM workflow to convert natural-language test-optimization requirements into executable quantum applications with traceable steps.
engineering_relevance: The approach lowers the quantum/programming expertise needed to prototype quantum software engineering solutions for real benchmark-driven optimization tasks.
method: Requirement parsing agent extracts task intent from NL prompts
Formulation, code generation, review, execution, and verification agents build and validate quantum workflows
Agentic decomposition is used to produce traceable end-to-end quantum applications
evidence_signal: On 20 real-world requirements, QPipe achieved 100% average code compilation and 96.7% average execution/final-result combination, with outputs often outperforming an offline genetic algorithm baseline.
watch_item: The system is token- and time-intensive, averaging 260.1 seconds and 1.89M tokens per requirement, which may limit practical scalability.
paper_title: Leveraging LLM-Based Agentic Systems to Generate Quantum Applications for Test Optimization
